name: 南京—浦口
administration_notes: 省界来自ENP-China民国时段研究图层；按官方沿革将河北还原为直隶、1928年前宁夏和青海合回甘肃。
京兆地方按已核实县籍标注节点；原研究图层没有京兆独立边界，故不编造该界线。
行政区划不等同于剧本军事控制；格子归属仍是游戏状态。

terrain_classification.method: SRTM90m_v3 center and four cardinal half-radius samples; relief required for hill and mountain classification, elevation alone never implies hills
terrain_classification.low_sample_policy: Original source values retained; affected support excluded from relief shading and contours, not asserted as real below-sea-level terrain.
terrain_classification.elevation_accuracy_notice: Radar DEM physical reference, not ground survey or historical land-use reconstruction. SRTM mission absolute vertical accuracy specification: 16 m at 90% confidence; this is not a per-cell guarantee.

notices: 江汉三镇和宁浦两岸保留独立节点；渡口不计入铁路。
粤汉线路仅开放当时南北分段，不连接1936年才贯通的缺口。
征服地图为东部中国战区，不宣称包括全国全部领土。
